_doc: Bosch Rexroth strut profile 45x45L: 45 x 45 mm with the 10 mm slot, anodised. Dimensions and section figures are from the MGE 14.0 catalogue, which prints them to 0.1 cm² and 0.1 cm⁴: on a section this small that is a step of several percent. The drawn outline leaves out the true shape of the corner hollows (drawn as squares of about the same area), the notches round the bore and the round core the slots end on.
